summary: E-Home Household Service Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its extraordinary general meeting held July 15, 2026. Shareholders approved a capital reorganization that reduces the par value of each issued ordinary share from US$1.25 to US$0.00001 by canceling US$1.24999 of paid-up capital, followed by subdividing authorized but unissued shares. The credit from the reduction will offset accumulated losses and any balance transferred to a distributable reserve. The authorized share capital structure is amended from 800M ordinary shares at US$1.25 par plus 10M preferred shares at US$0.002 par to 100 billion ordinary shares at US$0.00001 par plus 10M preferred shares at US$0.002 par. The reorganization does not involve a tender or distribution to shareholders. What to watch: accounting treatment of the distributable reserve and potential future capital returns.
